name: re-rule-after-size-fail

maps_to.criterion: Handoff redesign AC11: a dropped rule passing after a size failure.
maps_to.risk: After a predecessor that failed only on size, the writer drops a carried rule and the old validator downgrades the carry check to a WARN.

description: Source: a reproduced validator failure (a size-failed predecessor, then a successor that deleted a carried [R1], validated with a WARN), rewritten one-to-one as a session with every detail changed. Hard because the newest predecessor hot file is over the 24,600-byte cap, so the writer must shed bytes, and the hop-1 rule is the oldest, longest entry in Current rules; the reader's next action (merge a migration PR) breaks the rule if it is gone.
